title: TenderRequirementsExtractionDocument
description: Schema representing procurement requirements, technical parameters, and explicit standard citations extracted from a tender document.

document_metadata.description: Metadata regarding the uploaded tender or specification document.

document_id.description: Unique identifier for the parsed tender document.

document_title.description: Title or reference number of the tender document.

file_name.description: Original file name of the document.

page_count.description: Total number of pages in the tender document.

procuring_entity.description: Name of the government department, PSU, or organization issuing the tender.

product_context.description: High-level domain and product classification inferred from the tender specifications.

primary_item_name.description: Name of the primary equipment, item, or material sought.

category.description: Broad industrial or procurement domain (e.g. Electrical Cables, Structural Steel, Cement, Transformers).

summary.description: Brief executive summary of the technical scope.

extracted_requirements.description: Collection of individual technical parameters and requirements extracted from the tender.

already_cited_standards.description: Standard references (e.g., IS, ISO, IEC) explicitly named in the tender prose.

RequirementItem.description: A single extracted procurement requirement or technical specification.

requirement_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the requirement (e.g. 'REQ_001').

parameter_name.description: Standardized canonical name of the parameter (e.g., 'Tensile Strength', 'Conductor Resistance', 'Voltage Rating').

value.description: Raw extracted value string as written in the tender (e.g., '410 MPa min', '0.5 ohm/km max', '11 kV').

product_category_context.description: Contextual product tag associated with this parameter.

is_mandatory.description: True if the requirement is mandatory (shall/must); false if optional or desirable (may/should).

source_text.description: Verbatim sentence or clause from the tender containing the requirement.

extraction_confidence.description: Model confidence score for the extraction accuracy (0.0 to 1.0).

notes.description: Supplementary parsing notes, edge case observations, or disambiguation remarks.

NormalizedValue.description: Machine-readable parsed representation of quantitative/qualitative parameters for deterministic matching.

numeric_value.description: Single discrete numeric value if specified without inequality.

operator.description: Relational operator for evaluation against standard tolerance.

text_value.description: Canonical text representation if purely qualitative.

SourceLocation.description: Exact traceability location inside the tender document.

source_page.description: 1-indexed page number in the source document.

clause_number.description: Clause or section header reference (e.g., 'Clause 4.2.1', 'Section B').

line_number.description: Approximate line number on page if available.

table_identifier.description: Identifier or title of table if requirement was extracted from tabular data.

char_start.description: Optional 0-indexed character start offset for future UI text highlighting.

char_end.description: Optional 0-indexed character end offset for future UI text highlighting.

bounding_box.description: Optional bounding box coordinates on PDF page for future UI visual highlighting.

page_number.description: Page on which bounding box resides

AlreadyCitedStandard.description: An Indian or international standard reference explicitly cited by the tender author.

raw_citation.description: Verbatim citation text (e.g., 'IS 2062:1999 Grade A', 'as per IS:694 latest').

part_number.description: Part or section number if applicable (e.g., 'Part 1', 'Sec 2').

year_cited.description: Specific edition year cited in tender, if any (e.g., 1999).

clause_reference.description: Tender clause where the standard is referenced.
